key_insight: GRPO outperforms supervised fine-tuning for adapting ASR to synthetic speech, cutting WER much more effectively when real speech is scarce.
engineering_relevance: For privacy-constrained domains like banking, reinforcement learning on synthetic TTS data can deliver stronger ASR adaptation than SFT alone.
method: Adapt an LLM-based ASR model using synthetic speech only.
Apply critic-free GRPO with a low-WER reward signal.
Optionally combine SFT first, then GRPO for the best result.
evidence_signal: On synthetic-only adaptation, GRPO reduced WER from 36.71% to 22.09%, with SFT+GRPO improving it further by 45% relative to SFT.
watch_item: The method is evaluated on synthetic speech, so real-world gains may depend on how well the synthetic audio matches deployment acoustics.
paper_title: When Synthetic Speech Is All You Have: Better Call GRPO
